report_source: Complete prototype-evidence artifact downloaded via nightly.link; archive SHA-256 verified against the GitHub artifact API digest

limitations: One source-visible specialized solver; not two independent five-day attack teams.
Hidden-case pass rate does not prove correctness on all possible inputs.
Direct worker evaluation bypasses gateway admission and challenge lifecycle handling.
No LLM baseline or formal confidence-bound acceptance result is included.
Timing includes cold subprocess startup and is not the warmed-worker performance gate.
Issuance failures are availability failures, not successful defenses against a solver.
Tests two specific incorrect implementations, not model use.
Does not establish resistance to a correct specialized solver.
Engine-only results make no Linux OS isolation claim.
